_meta.what: Facts extracted from pysnmp/smi/mibs/, the base-layer modules pysmi 0.1.2/0.1.3 generated in April 2017.
_meta.why: Those files were deleted when best-match selection made pysmi's copies reachable (pysnmp/pysnmp#198). They stated no revision, so the tie rule kept handing them the win until they were gone. This is the baseline the equivalence harness compares against, so the characterization survives the deletion. Historical record: nothing regenerates it.
